headline: EBEP: De-escalation of Inflation Must Pass Through Shelf and Basket Indicators
summary: Greece has achieved significant disinflation and food inflation has eased noticeably, but high prices remain a problem. Officials say shelf and basket indicators must reflect the de-escalation.
why: Inflation trends in Greece influence consumer spending, wage negotiations and the European Central Bank's view of the euro area's peripheral economies.
